The Monument Airport , a.k.a. Phosphate Hill Airport is located at Phosphate Hill, Queensland, Australia.
Geography
Climate
Due to its very high evapotranspiration, the airport experiences a subtropical desert climate (Köppen: BWh) with very hot, somewhat wetter summers and very mild and very dry winters. The wettest recorded day was 27 March 2019 with  of rainfall. Extreme temperatures ranged from  on 1 December 2006 to  on 18 June 2001 and 17 July 2002.
